address: 210/218 Victoria Street West, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: With a retractable canopy and window awnings, Milenta in Victoria Park Market creates a seamless indoor-outdoor experience. Led by a Colombian chef, the kitchen team of LatAm origins delivers dishes that embody the bold, spice-driven flavours of this continent. Most proteins are cooked precisely over a wood fire, achieving perfectly charred, smoky depth. Try ceviche with salsa macha and kumara chips for a tangy, creamy, spicy kick.
